Name: Easy Access Buttons
Author: Yadm
Description:
[heading]More from Yadm[/heading]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54022]Hired Help[/url]. Hire a neighbor, pay them, and they walk the farm and do the chores. Choose from 12 neighbors and more than 50 jobs: water, hoe, plant, harvest, the greenhouse, animals, kegs, jars, casks, furnaces, forage, trees, and hay.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53092]Guild Kill List[/url]. After floor 100 of the Mines, the monster eradication list is on your inventory.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53287]Perfection Shortcut[/url]. After Qi's Walnut Room unlocks, an inventory button opens the game's perfection tracker.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53144]Staircase Spacing[/url]. A staircase stays in your bag when another ladder is already nearby in the Mines or Skull Cavern.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54345]Sprinklers All Day[/url]. A sprinkler fires every two hours when it has a dry tilled tile in reach. The 6:00 AM watering stays the same.


[size=5][color=#C4783A][b]One column[/b][/color][/size]
[line]

Mods that add an inventory button all aim for the same spot beside the bag, so the buttons cover each other. Easy Access Buttons gives them one shared column.

The column includes the Community Center button and Organize. Extra buttons fill downward, then a second column, then a third. When there are more than fit, the arrows under the column scroll them. The button under the column opens a menu where you reorder or hide any button. The trash can stays under the first column.

On a chest or a big chest, chest buttons sit beside the chest, and the Community Center button joins them. Fridges, the shipping bin, and the mini shipping bin do not have that button. Inventory buttons line up on their own side.

This mod works on its own. With no other mods installed, the column is the Community Center button, Organize, and the gear.

[size=5][color=#C4783A][b]Reorder or hide a button[/b][/color][/size]
[line]

Open the inventory and click the gear under the column. On a chest, that gear closes the chest and opens the same menu.

Each row has an up arrow, a down arrow, and a box. The arrows move that button up or down. The box hides it. A hidden button leaves the column, and the others close the gap. Click the box again to put it back.

On a chest the list is split into Chest and Player inventory. Click a heading to open or close that part. Closing one leaves the menu the same size. A scrollbar appears when the list is taller than the window.

Hover a row to see the button name and the mod that added it, or Vanilla. The wrench on a row opens that mod's options when it has them.

Reset puts every button back to the default order and shows the ones you hid.

[size=5][color=#C4783A][b]Install[/b][/color][/size]
[line]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Unzip the main file into Stardew Valley/Mods, or install it with Vortex[/*]
[*]For another mod's button, install the optional file Easy Access Buttons Auto Patcher[/*]
[*]Remove an older single patch for a mod if you install the Auto Patcher. Do not keep both[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][color=#C4783A][b]Uninstall[/b][/color][/size]
[line]

Remove Easy Access Buttons in your mod manager, or delete the EasyAccessButtons folder. Remove Easy Access Buttons Auto Patcher the same way if you installed it.

Buttons go back to the spot their own mod uses. The saved order is deleted with this mod's folder.


[size=5][color=#C4783A][b]Mods that join on their own[/b][/color][/size]
[line]
These mods call this one. Install Easy Access Buttons and the button lines up. Leave Easy Access Buttons out, and each keeps the button it had.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54022]Hired Help[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53092]Guild Kill List[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53287]Perfection Shortcut[/url]


[heading]Auto Patcher[/heading]

One optional file on this page moves these buttons into the column when that mod is installed. A mod that is not installed is skipped. Remove an older single patch for the same button. Leaving it installed skips that row, so the button stays where that patch put it.

Have a mod that could join? Leave a comment.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]. Organize Inventory on a chest.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32558]Convenient Chests 2[/url]. The stash button, and the lock, note, and categorize buttons.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url]. Quick Stack.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43127]UI Info Suite 2 Alternative[/url]. The calendar, billboard, and order icons.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url]. Bundle Overview.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51900]Qi's Perfection and Completion Tracker[/url]. The Qi Gem.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43136]Deluxe Grabber Fix[/url]. The global grabber star and the Name button on an auto-grabber. Needs Easy Access Buttons 1.0.5.


[size=5][color=#C4783A][b]Mods that still use their own spot[/b][/color][/size]
[line]

A mod that is not in the lists above still draws its own button. That button can cover this column.
 
Post the name here if you want it looked at.


[size=5][color=#3E6B8A][b]For mod authors[/b][/color][/size]
[line]
Made a mod and want it patched? Use the API to make a separate patch, or have your mod call the API itself. Both are explained below.

Your mod does not reference Easy Access Buttons.dll. Copy the interface below into your own project. The interface must be public, and it must not be nested inside another class. On GameLaunched, ask SMAPI for it:

[code]
var api = this.Helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IEasyAccessButtonsApi>("Yadm.EasyAccessButtons");
if (api is null)
    return;[/code]
Null means this mod is not installed. There are two ways to list the dependency.

Use IsRequired true when your button only makes sense in the column. SMAPI will not load your mod without Easy Access Buttons.

[code]
"Dependencies": [
  { "UniqueID": "Yadm.EasyAccessButtons", "IsRequired": true }
][/code]
Use IsRequired false when your mod should still load on its own. Keep your old button when GetApi returns null.

[code]
"Dependencies": [
  { "UniqueID": "Yadm.EasyAccessButtons", "IsRequired": false }
][/code]
[size=5][color=#3E6B8A][b]Add a button this mod draws[/b][/color][/size]
[line]

AddButton registers a button. Easy Access Buttons draws it, shows the tooltip, plays the select sound, and runs your click. The same id replaces the previous registration. An empty id is ignored.

[code]
public interface IEasyAccessButtonsApi
{
    void AddButton(string id, int order, Texture2D texture, Rectangle sourceRect, int iconSize, Func<bool> isVisible, Func<string> tooltip, Action onClick);
    void RemoveButton(string id);
    void Reserve(string id, int order, Func<bool> isVisible);
    void Reserve(string id, int order, Func<bool> isVisible, Func<string> name, Texture2D? icon, Rectangle sourceRect);
    Rectangle GetBounds(string id);
    void SetSettings(string id, Action open);

    void AddButton(string screen, string id, int order, Texture2D texture, Rectangle sourceRect, int iconSize, Func<bool> isVisible, Func<string> tooltip, Action onClick);
    void RemoveButton(string screen, string id);
    void Reserve(string screen, string id, int order, Func<bool> isVisible);
    void Reserve(string screen, string id, int order, Func<bool> isVisible, Func<string> name, Texture2D? icon, Rectangle sourceRect);
    Rectangle GetBounds(string screen, string id);
}[/code]
[code]
api.AddButton(
    id: "tracker",
    order: 0,
    texture: Game1.mouseCursors,
    sourceRect: new Rectangle(346, 400, 8, 8),
    iconSize: 32,
    isVisible: () => this.Config.Enabled,
    tooltip: () => this.Helper.Translation.Get("button.tooltip"),
    onClick: this.OpenTracker);[/code]
[list]
[*]id is unique inside your mod. It is stored as your UniqueID, a slash, and that id.[/*]
[*]order: a lower number sits higher until the player rearranges the list. The same number is sorted by id. The Community Center button and Organize use lower numbers than a normal mod button, so yours starts under them.[/*]
[*]iconSize is the icon in pixels inside the 64-pixel cell.[/*]
[*]isVisible is checked every layout. False removes the button from the column and closes the gap. The row stays in the gear menu, greyed, with a note that your mod is hiding it.[/*]
[*]tooltip is the hover text. Empty draws no tooltip.[/*]
[*]onClick runs after the select sound, while the inventory menu is still open. Do not play that sound again. A click with an item on the cursor is left for the game.[/*]
[*]To open another menu, close the inventory menu and open the next menu on the following tick.[/*]
[*]The player's saved order is kept. A button this mod has not seen before is added at the end of that list until the player moves it. Reset in the gear menu clears the saved list.[/*]
[*]RemoveButton drops a button you added or reserved.[/*]
[/list]
The methods without a screen still mean the inventory page. A copied interface from before 1.0.2 keeps working.

screen is inventory or container. Container is a chest, a fridge, the shipping bin, and the mini shipping bin. They share one saved order. A button whose check returns false drops out of that column and the rest close up.

SetSettings adds a gear on that button's row in the layout screen. The gear runs open. Generic Mod Config Menu can open that mod's page on top of the layout with OpenModMenuAsChildMenu, and closing it returns here. A row without SetSettings has no gear. One call arms the row on every screen that uses that id.

[size=5][color=#3E6B8A][b]Move a button your mod still draws[/b][/color][/size]
[line]

Use this when your mod already has a button and should keep drawing, clicking, and showing its own tooltip. Reserve claims a cell. Easy Access Buttons does not draw that icon. The longer Reserve also supplies the gear-menu name and icon. An empty source rectangle uses the whole texture.

After the page lays out, GetBounds returns that cell. It returns an empty rectangle when the button is hidden, scrolled off, or the page has not been laid out yet. Write that rectangle onto your own widget. Use the same id you passed to Reserve. When the rectangle is empty, park the widget off the page so it is not left on its old spot. Do not draw the icon a second time.

[code]
api.Reserve(
    id: "overview",
    order: 30,
    isVisible: () => true,
    name: () => "Bundle Overview",
    icon: this.Icon,
    sourceRect: new Rectangle(0, 0, 61, 56));

Rectangle cell = api.GetBounds("overview");[/code]
[size=5][color=#3E6B8A][b]A separate patch[/b][/color][/size]
[line]

Someone else can ship a patch for a mod that does not call this API. That patch is its own mod. It is not part of Easy Access Buttons, and it is not part of the Auto Patcher.

On GameLaunched, ask for the API. Reserve claims the cell. After the other mod places its button, GetBounds returns that cell. Write that rectangle onto the other mod's button from a Harmony postfix with Priority.Last, so it runs after that mod picks its own spot. Use the same id for both calls. When the rectangle is empty, park the button off the page.

Depend on Yadm.EasyAccessButtons. Use IsRequired false, and skip the patch when GetApi returns null. Do not reference Easy Access Buttons.dll.

Post the link here if you publish one. Do not install it together with the Auto Patcher for the same button.
